tab <- matrix(c(400,100,200,300), nrow=2, byrow=TRUE, dimnames=list(c('High','Low'), c('Rapid','Delayed')))
p <- tab/sum(tab)
pLow <- sum(p['Low',])
pRapid <- sum(p[,'Rapid'])
pHR <- p['High','Rapid']
num <- pRapid^2 - pHR^2
den <- 1 - (1 - pLow)^2
answer <- num/den
answers.note: P(both rapid and at least one low) = P(both rapid) - P(both high-rapid), divided by P(at least one low).
